name: Rock Gnome
desc: Rock Gnomes possess a natural curiosity and inventiveness regarding mechanical marvels.

traits.name: Rock Gnome Lineage
traits.desc: You know the Mending and Prestidigitation cantrips. In addition, using Prestidigitation, you can spend 10 minutes creating a Tiny clockwork device (such as a toy, firestarter, or music box) that functions for 8 hours or until dismantled.
